objective: forward the exact color-backbuffer initialization commands used by pinned DXVK's Tomb Raider D3D9 device reset while keeping every pointer and Vulkan aggregate local to its ABI

call_locations: D3D9SwapChainEx::CreateBackBuffers lines 1015-1072 injects the target non-Ex device's one through three backbuffers plus optional frontbuffer into DxvkContext::initImage
DxvkContext::initImage lines 960-996 records zero vkCmdClearColorImage and the undefined-to-transfer-dst transition
DxvkContext::endCurrentCommands lines 8478-8487 finalizes the accumulated init barrier batch
DxvkBarrierBatch::flush lines 483-507 calls the core vkCmdPipelineBarrier2 wrapper

cpu_invocation: vkCmdPipelineBarrier2 on InitBarriers when command recording is finalized
audited_order.semantic_reason: the command lists are recorded in clear-then-finalize order but submitted in barrier-before-clear order

supported_shape.images_per_barrier_batch: one through four distinct color backbuffer images

clear.subresource: color aspect, base mip zero, one mip, base layer zero, one layer

image_barrier.subresource: color aspect, base mip zero, one mip, base layer zero, one layer

wire.representation: typed command-buffer ID, one to four typed image IDs, count, and zeroed reserved slots; all Vulkan constants are validated and reconstructed rather than transmitted
wire.native_reconstruction: the Bionic service resolves same-device native handles and reconstructs local VkDependencyInfo, VkImageMemoryBarrier2 array, VkClearColorValue, and VkImageSubresourceRange records

ownership.client: every image proxy must be a live child of the command buffer's device
ownership.service: every image and command buffer must resolve to the same typed wire device ID and native VkDevice

fail_closed: null, unknown, or extended dependency and image-barrier pNext chains
memory barriers, buffer barriers, dependency flags, zero images, more than four images, or duplicate image IDs
non-zero clear values, non-transfer-destination layouts, multiple ranges, or non-canonical subresource ranges
non-canonical stage, access, layout, or queue-family fields
wrong-type, stale, missing, or cross-device command-buffer and image IDs
malformed lengths, non-zero reserved words, or non-zero unused image slots

dispatch_policy.baseline: E068's complete 86-name executable list, including core buffer requirements2 and buffer device address
dispatch_policy.promotion: core vkCmdClearColorImage and core vkCmdPipelineBarrier2 only
dispatch_policy.khr_alias: vkCmdPipelineBarrier2KHR remains required_unimplemented because pinned DXVK's loader declares only the core member

verification.canonical_codec: round trips both fixed records and rejects wrong handle types, duplicate image IDs, non-zero unused slots, malformed reserved words, and out-of-range batch counts

corrected_sparse_audit.effect: E067 was cancelled from target-specific native feature truth rather than inferred call order
